description: Core quality cases for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and generic coding-agent enhancement.

cases.prompt: fix the typo in the settings button

preserve: Only a settings-button typo needs correction.
Investigate and fix the upload failure without assuming its cause.

cases.prompt: uploads over 5MB return 500; fix it without changing the public API

preserve: The public API must remain unchanged.
shouldInclude: Test below, at, and above the boundary
mustAvoid: Assuming a specific server or storage provider

cases.prompt: add rate limiting to the login endpoint using existing project patterns, no new dependencies

shouldInclude: Discover the login path and existing middleware
mustAvoid: Changing authentication behavior beyond rate limiting

cases.prompt: refactor config loading to remove duplication but keep behavior and file format unchanged

preserve: Behavior and persisted file format must not change.

cases.prompt: write tests for billing edge cases; do not modify production behavior

shouldInclude: Inspect existing billing behavior and test conventions

cases.prompt: users may be able to read files outside the upload directory; investigate and fix safely

preserve: Investigate possible file reads outside the upload directory
Implement a safe fix if confirmed.
shouldInclude: Add traversal and valid-path regression tests
mustAvoid: Weak string-prefix validation as the prescribed solution

cases.prompt: the dashboard gets slow with many users, check for N+1 queries and fix only if confirmed

preserve: Only fix N+1 behavior if evidence confirms it.
shouldInclude: Verify query count and response behavior after changes
mustAvoid: Claiming N+1 is the root cause

cases.prompt: the checkout integration test flakes in CI but passes locally; diagnose before changing code

preserve: The failure differs between CI and local runs.
shouldInclude: Add a regression test when a valid seam exists

cases.prompt: add search to the history screen using Svelte 5 runes and preserve the current IPC contract

shouldInclude: Inspect existing history state and UI conventions
mustAvoid: Adding a search dependency without need

cases.prompt: replace the deprecated parser internally while keeping the exported API backward compatible
In the existing CSV export flow, preserve column order, add UTF-8 BOM only for Excel downloads, keep API downloads unchanged, and add tests for both paths. Do not add dependencies.

preserve: BOM applies only to Excel downloads
shouldInclude: Discover how Excel and API paths are distinguished
